message.content:
I’m afraid there isn’t a Quentin Tarantino feature that *stars* Lawrence Bender—he’s best known as a producer rather than an actor.  
However, Bender did produce several of Tarantino’s most iconic films:

| Film | Year | Role of Lawrence Bender |
|------|------|------------------------|
| **“Pulp Fiction”** | 1994 | Producer |
| **“Kill Bill: Volume 1 & 2”** | 2003‑04 | Executive Producer |
| **“Inglourious Basterds”** | 2009 | Co‑producer |

If you’re interested in watching a Tarantino movie connected to Bender, any of those would work great.  

Alternatively, here are a few classic Tarantino titles that showcase stellar performances (and don’t involve Bender):

| Title | Lead Actors |
|-------|-------------|
| “Django Unchained” | Jamie Foxx, Leonardo DiCaprio |
| “Once Upon a Time…in Hollywood” | Leonardo DiCaprio, Brad Pitt |
| “Death Proof” | Kurt Russell, Rosario Dawson |

Let me know which direction you'd prefer—or if you'd like recommendations outside of Tarantino!
